eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 3:26 PM on AUG 23, 2023 Effective until 3:26 PM AUG 24, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: All residents in the Singer area and north to Fred Cloessner Road, particularly on the East side of the road the Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office is issuing a voluntary evacuation notice for this area. Fire conditions have intensified and residence should prepare themselves to evacuate quickly if advised and monitor further notices. Make preparations per CAP instructions
